== June 2017 partial and full-image chronology ==
The official [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Decipher Errata]] document dates its text to June 1, 2017 and prints a Hypo partial on PDF page 6. That partial precedes full Holotable images first recorded 2018-07-08 and 2024-01-27. The document date does not establish original publication day. Source assets and article histories are preserved. Bare current gameplay mapping <code>2_112</code> remains with image 3. No historical executable ID is invented. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== Uncovered original fields beneath the June 2017 cutout ==
The source cover directs placing the lower cutout in a sleeve with the original physical card. Its replacement begins at the type band, below the original title, destiny and lore. The original [[:File:ANewHope-D-hypo-decipher-archive.gif]] supplies the still-uncovered destiny 5 and literal lore; later full PC faces are not the source of these inherited values. Existing lower-slip text, images, numbering, links and executable IDs are retained. Cover/source: [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], PDF page 6. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
